svg.text: ARS-PT-9713 · size M · baggy fit · twill
“make baggy pants, lengthen the legs and raise the waist by 2 cm”
note: 3.2 cm of front waist goes into a pleat (the side seam takes at most 5.0 cm)
fusible interfacing for waistband, fly shield
seam allowance 15 mm and hems 40 mm included in every piece
Aras · drafted from body measurements by hand-written rules · same sentence, same rules.toml, same sheet
